jobs.title: Partnership Operations Manager
jobs.description:
THE SHORT VERSION

You own Viktor's partner pipeline end to end: finding creators, agencies and newsletters, deciding which ones are real, negotiating what we pay them, and proving what came back.

The channel already works and already has budget behind it. What it needs is one person who owns the operating layer, and that layer is a real job, not a coordination role.

 


WHAT'S ACTUALLY GOING ON HERE

Viktor is an AI teammate that lives in Slack, connects to 3,200+ tools, and does real work. 56,000+ workspaces have hired him. We raised a $75M Series A led by Accel in May 2026, and we are about forty people heading toward a hundred.

Partnerships is one of our fastest-compounding acquisition channels: hundreds of creators, multiple agencies, newsletter sponsorships and an ambassador program, with full-funnel attribution from spend through to signups. Right now the Head of Influencer Partnerships runs all of it. This seat takes the operating half.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

 - Source partners and run the outbound that finds them: creator discovery through Modash and engagement signals, agency and newsletter prospecting, inbound triage.

 - Qualify every one of them against our framework: audience quality, fake and farm detection, ICP fit, CPM band. Then produce a shortlist someone can decide from.

 - Negotiate pricing and terms inside agreed bands. Know when to push, when to bundle, and when to walk.

 - Run live placements from brief to draft to go-live to stats, and grade partners on what actually happened rather than what was promised.

 - Turn the ones that work into multi-month commitments, and keep the trackers, invoicing and payment reconciliation clean enough that the numbers are trusted.

 - Supervise and extend the automations Viktor already runs on this workflow, rather than doing it all by hand.

Final calls on new partner categories and off-band pricing stay with the Head of Influencer Partnerships. Paid ads, brand social and product integrations sit elsewhere.

 


THE BAR

Bring named campaigns, roster sizes, budgets and CPMs you can walk through. We will reconcile the last two years campaign by campaign, and we will ask what you personally built rather than what your team had.

We will also give you a real roster with real fee quotes and ask you to tell us which ones are inflated.

 


HOW YOU'LL KNOW IT'S WORKING

 - Day 30. The weekly placement pipeline runs without escalation. Drafts get feedback within 24 hours.

 - Day 90. 150+ partners sourced and scored, 15+ booked. Three multi-month deals signed inside the target blended CPM band. Monthly reconciliation done independently. A Friday performance report that nobody has to restructure.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have run creator or partner campaign operations at volume: 50+ placements a quarter, or a roster of 100+, with the budgets to match.

 - You have negotiated against a number (CPM, ER or CAC), and you can explain how you priced something and the time you walked away.

 - You built the operational backbone yourself. The tracker with live formulas, the stats pipeline, the payment reconciliation. Not a tool someone handed you.

 - You have caught an inflated or fake partner before the money went out, and you can name the signals you used.

 - You write a lot, in English, and it is good. Partner emails, draft feedback, async updates. This is most of the job's surface area.

 


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have worked B2B rather than only consumer, and know why the CPM maths differs.

 - You have run an affiliate, ambassador or newsletter program alongside creators.

 - You already use AI tooling to take the repetitive half off your plate.

 


PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF

 - Your influencer experience is gifting and seeding with no CPM or funnel discipline.

 - Your background is scheduling posts: no negotiation, no budget, no number you were accountable for.

 - You want to set direction and hand off the spreadsheet-level work. In year one that work is the job.

 - You need a meeting to move something forward.

 - You would rather AI stayed out of your workflow.

 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

 - You co-own a channel that already works and is already attributed, instead of building the case for one.

 - Unusual leverage: Viktor automates large parts of this workflow, so one operator here covers what a four-person team does elsewhere, and you shape those automations.

 - Full-funnel visibility, spend through to revenue, rather than impressions and vibes.

 - A direct line to the Head of Influencer Partnerships and the founders, and a credible path to owning a sub-channel outright inside 6 to 12 months.

 


HOW WE WORK

Small team, high trust, low process. Decisions are made by owners, not committees. You will ship your first week. You will talk to users your first day. 

We don't do alignment meetings or stakeholder syncs. We build things, see if they work, and iterate.




WHY VIKTOR

We're one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. The product works. The market is pulling. 

This is a rare window: everyone here owns something real. Not a task. A surface of the company that customers depend on. 

That doesn't last forever. Right now, it's still true.




COMPENSATION

Top-of-the-market salary and the kind of ownership that only exists at this stage.

The best work happens when you're in the room. Munich, New York, Dublin, and Warsaw. Remote for some roles.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead (Google Ads)
jobs.description:
THE SHORT VERSION

You own Google as a paid acquisition channel for Viktor. Search, Performance Max, YouTube, the full Google ad stack - strategy, keyword and audience structure, budget, performance. You've built this machine before, at scale. Now you build it again - with better tools, more budget discipline, and no legacy to work around.

 


WHAT'S ACTUALLY GOING ON HERE

Viktor is an AI-native product growing fast. We're standing up paid acquisition as a serious discipline as part of the paid acquisition team, and Google is one of the channels we believe in. You'll be the founding owner of it - end-to-end, no agency layer. You'll build the playbook, set the bar and scale the program.

Day-1 operator. Day-180 architect of how Viktor runs Google, using AI tooling to compound your output.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

 - Own Google Ads end-to-end. Search campaign structure, keyword strategy, match-type discipline, negative keyword hygiene, PMax asset groups, YouTube where it earns its budget.

 - Run landing page and conversion path experiments alongside the ad work. Quality Score and post-click conversion are part of your job.

 - Set the experimentation cadence. Weekly tests with clear hypotheses, documented results, compounding learnings.

 - Own measurement and attribution. Enhanced conversions, offline conversion import, conversion modeling.

 - Build the keyword, audience, and asset library. The playbook compounds.

 - Report weekly on spend, CAC, pipeline contribution. Numbers, not narrative.

 - Work to build out a culture of excellence across all paid acquisition done by the team

 


THE BAR

You'll be measured on pipeline and CAC from Google. Not on impression share, CTR, or campaign count. "I'd need a PPC specialist and a landing page team" is an instant no-hire. You're both.

 


HOW YOU'LL KNOW IT'S WORKING

30 days: account audited, bad match types killed, conversion tracking clean, first experiments shipped. 90 days: Google is a predictable, scaling channel with a documented playbook and a hiring rubric for the next seat.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - 4-8 years running paid search, with deep Google Ads experience for B2B SaaS or AI. Pipeline-accountable.

 - Direct media buyer at scale. You've worked directly on acquisition campaigns in the platform - not through an agency - with serious media spend ($1M+/month). You owned the spend and the outcome.

 - Attribution fluency. GA4 and pixel implementation, enhanced and offline conversions, server-side event optimization.

 - You think about the whole conversion path. Ad to landing page to signup to paying.

 - Documented experimentation practice. You can show the cadence and the wins from a prior role.

 - AI-native daily workflow. Claude and similar tools are core to how you work.

 - You've leveled people up before. You can take a sharp 1-2 year operator and make them dangerous.

 - You raise the bar. Your playbook becomes the house playbook.

 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

 - No agency layer. You own the account.

 - The CMO and the co-founders care about how Viktor grows. You'll have data; they'll have opinions. The good ideas win.

 - The product makes the work easier. The right buyer converts when they land. Your job is making sure the right buyer lands.

 


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You've scaled paid search from zero at a Series A or B B2B SaaS.

 - You've worked on AI or PLG products.

 - You've owned landing page experimentation alongside the ad account.

 


HOW WE WORK

Small team, high trust, low process. Decisions are made by owners, not committees. You will ship your first week. You will talk to users your first day. 

We don't do alignment meetings or stakeholder syncs. We build things, see if they work, and iterate.




WHY VIKTOR

We're one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. The product works. The market is pulling. 

This is a rare window: everyone here owns something real. Not a task. A surface of the company that customers depend on. 

That doesn't last forever. Right now, it's still true.




COMPENSATION

Top-of-the-market salary and the kind of ownership that only exists at this stage.

The best work happens when you're in the room. Munich, New York, Dublin, and Warsaw. Remote for some roles.
